players.name: Cal Raleigh
players.summary: Raleigh has homered 5 times in his last 7 games, erasing a brutal early-season slump (.161 before April 20). SEA won 7-1 over MIN behind a three-hit game each from Julio Rodríguez and Taylor Naylor.

sources.title: Cal Raleigh Is Once Again Making Mariners Panic Look Like a Terrible Investment

players.name: Bryce Harper
players.summary: Phillies blanked the Giants 7-0 with Jesus Luzardo going 7 shutout innings. Don Mattingly managed his first game for Philadelphia after the team fired its previous skipper. Harper contributed an RBI double.

sources.title: SF Giants shut out by Phillies in Don Mattingly's first game as Philadelphia's manager

players.name: Luis Arraez
players.summary: Giants were shut out for an MLB-leading 6th time this season in a 7-0 loss. Arraez doubled but was stranded; SFG managed only 2 hits all game against Luzardo.

sources.title: Phillies post 2-hit shutout of Giants in first game since manager's firing

players.name: Bo Bichette
players.summary: Bichette opened scoring with a leadoff HR on the very first pitch of the game, then added a sacrifice fly in the 4th. Mets erupted for a big inning en route to an 8-0 shutout of Washington.

sources.title: Soto and Bichette go deep as slumping Mets break out in 8-0 win over Nationals

players.name: Francisco Lindor
players.summary: Lindor remains on the 10-day IL with a left calf strain suffered April 22 vs Minnesota. Mets re-evaluate in 3 weeks; projected 3–8 week absence. Ronny Mauricio recalled as replacement.

sources.title: Francisco Lindor to be reevaluated in three weeks

players.name: Pete Crow-Armstrong
players.summary: PCA ended a 3-week homer drought with a clutch 3-run blast in the 7th inning to break open an 8-3 Cubs win vs San Diego. Cubs snapped a 3-game losing skid.

sources.title: Pete Crow-Armstrong hits 3-run homer and Cubs beat Padres 8-3 to stop 3-game slide

players.name: Jackson Merrill
players.summary: Padres fell 3-8 to the Cubs as starter Walker Buehler surrendered 5 runs. Padres manager Craig Stammen left mid-game to attend a funeral; bench coach Randy Knorr finished managing.

sources.title: MLB Gameday: Cubs 8, Padres 3 Final Score (04/28/2026)

players.name: Teoscar Hernández
players.summary: Hernández sparked the Dodgers' offense with a 2-run single in the 1st inning, scoring Freeman and Ohtani. Kyle Tucker delivered a walk-off single to complete a Dodgers comeback win over Miami.

sources.title: Kyle Tucker's walkoff single caps Dodgers' rally past Marlins

players.name: Giancarlo Stanton
players.summary: Stanton officially placed on the 10-day IL April 28 with a low-grade right calf strain suffered April 24 vs Houston while jogging to second base. MRI confirmed low-grade; Aaron Boone optimistic about a relatively quick return.

sources.title: Yankees place DH Giancarlo Stanton (calf) on IL

players.name: Devin Williams
players.summary: Williams sat out the Mets' 8-0 blowout win over Washington. His early 2026 has been difficult with an ERA near 10.00 through 8 appearances; Mets are considering a reduced role.

sources.title: Why the Mets Should Move Devin Williams Out of the Closer Role

players.name: Zack Wheeler
players.summary: Wheeler debuted April 26 vs Atlanta (5 IP, 2 ER, 6 K) in PHI's 8-5 extra-inning win. Velocity looked good after offseason blood-clot surgery; next start likely May 1.

sources.title: Zack Wheeler returns strong as Phillies end losing streak

players.name: Cole Ragans
players.summary: Ragans bounced back with an 11-K gem April 25 (6 IP, 1 ER, 0 BB) vs the Angels for his first 2026 win after a 0-4 start. Next start expected around April 30.

sources.title: Cole Ragans strikes out 11 in first win of 2026

players.name: Chase Burns
players.summary: Burns recorded his 100th career strikeout — the fastest Reds pitcher ever to reach the milestone — during his 6-inning, 9-K gem vs Colorado. His season ERA stands at 2.60 through 6 starts.

sources.title: Chase Burns makes Reds history in start against the Colorado Rockies

players.name: Nathan Eovaldi
players.summary: Eovaldi is scheduled to start April 29 vs the Yankees (Jacob deGrom started the April 28 game for TEX). Eovaldi has a 5.79 ERA through 6 starts in 2026.

sources.title: Yankees vs. Rangers: Series preview, probable pitchers

players.name: Emmet Sheehan
players.summary: Sheehan pitched a gem April 24 vs the Cubs (6.1 IP, 10 K, career high) but the Dodgers bullpen blew the lead. Shohei Ohtani started April 28 vs Miami; Sheehan's next start is May 1 vs St. Louis.

sources.title: Dodgers waste Emmet Sheehan's gem in stunning loss to Cubs

players.name: Reid Detmers
players.summary: Detmers holds a 3.89 ERA through 6 starts and has been one of the Angels' most reliable starters in 2026. José Soriano started the April 28 game vs Chicago; Detmers's next turn is later this week.

sources.title: Reid Detmers Is Rewarding the Angels' Faith in the Rotation

injuries.name: Francisco Lindor
injuries.note: Left calf strain suffered April 22 vs Twins. In walking boot for 1 week; re-evaluation in 3 weeks. Could miss 3–8 weeks total.

source.title: Francisco Lindor to be reevaluated in three weeks

injuries.name: Giancarlo Stanton
injuries.note: Low-grade right calf strain. Injured April 24 jogging to second base vs Astros; officially placed on IL April 28. Return TBD; Boone optimistic.

source.title: Yankees place DH Giancarlo Stanton (calf) on IL
